title: CreateImagePayload
description: Object that represents an Image and its parameters. Used for Creating and returning (get/list).

DiskFormat.description:
Object that represents a disk format.
Possible values: `raw`, `qcow2`, `iso`.

GenericName.description: The name for a General Object. Matches Names and also UUIDs.

ImageAgent.description: Support status and default provioning setting for the STACKIT server agent.

provisionByDefault.description: Default provioning of the STACKIT server agent for new servers. The default for new images is false. Can only be enabled when supported is also true.

supported.description: Indicates the STACKIT server agent for the image. The default for new images is false.

algorithm.description:
Algorithm for the checksum of the image data.
Possible values: `md5`, `sha512`.

digest.description: Hexdigest of the checksum of the image data.

ImageConfig.description: Properties to set hardware and scheduling settings for an Image.

architecture.description:
Represents CPU architecture. The default for new images is x86.
Possible values: `arm64`, `x86`.

bootMenu.description: Enables the BIOS bootmenu. The default for new images is disabled.

cdromBus.description:
Sets CDROM bus controller type.
Possible values: `scsi`, `virtio`, `ide`, `usb`.

diskBus.description:
Sets Disk bus controller type.
Possible values: `scsi`, `virtio`, `ide`, `usb`.

nicModel.description:
Sets virtual nic model.
Possible values: `e1000`, `e1000e`, `ne2k_pci`, `pcnet`, `rtl8139`, `virtio`, `vmxnet3`.

operatingSystem.description:
Enables OS specific optimizations.
Possible values: `windows`, `linux`.

rescueBus.description:
Sets the device bus when the image is used as a rescue image.
Possible values: `sata`, `scsi`, `virtio`, `usb`.

rescueDevice.description:
Sets the device when the image is used as a rescue image.
Possible values: `cdrom`, `disk`.

secureBoot.description: Enables Secure Boot. The default for new images is disabled.

uefi.description: Configure UEFI boot. The default for new images is enabled.

videoModel.description:
Sets Graphic device model.
Possible values: `vga`, `cirrus`, `vmvga`, `qxl`, `virtio`, `none`.

virtioScsi.description: Enables the use of VirtIO SCSI to provide block device access. By default servers use VirtIO Block.

ImageProtected.description: When true the image is prevented from being deleted.

ImageScope.description:
Scope of an Image.
Possible values: `public`, `local`, `projects`, `organization`.

ImageStatus.description:
The status of an image object.
Possible values: `AVAILABLE`, `CREATING`, `DEACTIVATED`, `DELETED`, `DELETING`, `ERROR`.

Labels.description:
Object that represents the labels as key-value pairs of a resource.
Key constraints: - May contain an optional domain prefix separated by a slash (`/`). - Domain prefix must be less than or equal to 250 characters. - Domain prefix must ba a valid DNS subdomain containing only lowercase alphanumerics (`[a-z0-9]`) and dashes (`-`), separated by dots (`.`). - Length (excluding the domain prefix) must be between 1 and 63 characters. - Must begin and end with an alphanumerical character (`[a-z0-9A-Z]`). - May contain dashes (`-`), underscores (`_`), dots (`.`), and alphanumerics in between. - Keys starting with the prefix `stackit-` or having a domain prefix of `stackit.cloud` (including its subdomains, e.g., `*.stackit.cloud/`) are reserved for system use.
Value constraints: - Must be less than or equal to 63 characters long (can be empty). - If not empty it must begin and end with an alphanumeric character (`[a-z0-9A-Z]`). - May contain dashes (`-`), underscores (`_`), dots (`.`), and alphanumerics in between.
A resource can have a maximum of 64 labels. Reserved labels are excluded from this count. Providing a `null` value for a key will remove that key.

UpdatedAt.description: Date-time when resource was last updated.

v1ImageImportProgress.description: Indicates Image Import Progress in percent.
